eight_expert.note: Eight experts, three protected tasks, seven complete test datasets; TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes only the protected expert. EuroSAT is excluded; no eight-task mean. Partner losses remain in the table.

attacks.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distill. denotes hard-label student training on extra unlabeled images; ProDistill is reported separately. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. Higher standalone accuracy and lower merged accuracy favor protection.

partners.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distill. denotes hard-label student training on extra unlabeled images; ProDistill is reported separately. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. These are partner accuracies, not protection scores.

feature_distillation.note: Two-expert adaptation of the fixed author coefficient kernel. The attacker uses 64 unlabeled training images per task, task identity, and 100 epochs per block. Initial coefficient 0.3; no AGA preprocessing. Final LayerNorm and projection are not optimized. Defense 1 reuses identical unprotected blocks. Lower target accuracy favors protection; partner accuracy is reported separately. Standalone accuracy is reported in the main attack table.

defense2_versions.note: The earlier and updated Defense 2 releases use distinct frozen construction rules; each row uses one release throughout. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA processes the protected expert. Calibration uses 64 random images. ProDistill uses 64 unlabeled training images per task and coefficient initialization 0.3, with no AGA preprocessing. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD are paired with MNIST. Known-module replacement is reported separately; neither version resists it.

defense2_version_partners.note: The earlier and updated Defense 2 releases use distinct frozen construction rules; each row uses one release throughout. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA processes the protected expert. Calibration uses 64 random images. ProDistill uses 64 unlabeled training images per task and coefficient initialization 0.3, with no AGA preprocessing. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD are paired with MNIST. Known-module replacement is reported separately; neither version resists it.

defense2_eight_versions.note: The same earlier and updated releases as the two-expert version tables. Eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2; AGA processes only the protected expert. Seven complete test datasets, including all evaluated partner tasks. Unprotected weights and scores match between versions. EuroSAT is excluded; no eight-task mean. Lower protected-task accuracy favors protection; losses on other tasks are reported without averaging.

defense2_eight_calibration.note: Same frozen updated Defense 2 releases; eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model is calibrated independently using 64 fixed random images and its public classifier, without real images, labels or changed-module knowledge. Full archived scores are reused. Seven complete datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

defense2_eight_calibration_target.note: Same frozen updated Defense 2 releases; eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model is calibrated independently using 64 fixed random images and its public classifier, without real images, labels or changed-module knowledge. Full archived scores are reused. Seven complete datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

prodistill_components.note: Complete test accuracy. Other parameters remain fixed at the trained ProDistill model. A and B include their respective biases. Initial values use the same 0.3 initialization; trained values come from one completed joint coefficient fit. These are fixed component substitutions, not separately trained A-only or B-only attacks. Both-trained scores are reused from the same frozen model. No new optimization.
